correctness.rationale: For M=2p the exact-order-two criterion is d=M/gcd(q,M)>1 and d divides q+floor(qr/M). Every smaller quotient q<q0 is impossible as Q<d. At q0, Q=p gives an exact finite interval for r with coprimality. Solving it yields the stated five cases. Exact Fraction enumeration verifies 54,141 qualifying reduced numerators as a cross-check, not as the infinite proof.
